data.one_liner: A Flutter widget and utility to monitor internet connectivity status by pinging a remote server.
data.what_it_does: It provides a ConnectivityWidget with a builder to display different UIs depending on whether the phone has internet access. It verifies actual internet availability by pinging a remote server alongside network/WiFi status, and offers a ConnectivityUtils class for stream-based and future-based checks.
use_when: You need to display online or offline UI states based on real internet connectivity rather than just network interface status.
You want to execute callbacks when the device transitions between online and offline states.
avoid_when: You are targeting web applications where browser request caching can lead to uncertain connection verification results.
You only need local network interface type detection without pinging external endpoints.
strengths: Verifies true internet connectivity by pinging a remote server instead of just checking local network state.
Provides both UI builder widgets and utility streams for checking connection status anywhere in the app.
weaknesses: Web browser request caching can interfere with reliable connection verification.
Relies on external server availability for ping checks.
